title: Ứng dụng sẽ không chấp nhận thẻ của tôi
englishTitle: The app will not accept my card
pronunciation: Ung dung se khong chap nhan the cua toi
summary: For showing a payment screen when an app refuses your card.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use it with a ride, delivery, ticket, hotel, or SIM app when the error is visible on your phone.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the error screen first. Then ask for help switching payment, trying another card, or paying another way.

phrases.vietnamese: Ứng dụng sẽ không chấp nhận thẻ của tôi
phrases.english: The app will not accept my card
phrases.pronunciation: Ung dung se khong chap nhan the cua toi

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Ứng dụng means the app; sẽ không chấp nhận means will not accept; thẻ của tôi means my card.

breakdown.vietnamese: Ứng dụng sẽ không chấp nhận thẻ của tôi
breakdown.english: The app will not accept my card

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Declined card, try another card, and card machine not working phrases help when the problem moves from app to payment.

phrases.vietnamese: Thẻ của tôi đã bị từ chối
phrases.pronunciation: The cua toi da bi tu choi

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi có thể thử thẻ khác được không?
phrases.pronunciation: Toi co the thu the khac duoc khong

phrases.english: The card machine is not working

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at hotel desks, SIM shops, ride pickup points, ticket counters, and cafes when staff can see the failed payment.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Keep the phone in your hand if money is involved. Let them point, read, or type only what you allow.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: QR payment, payment went through, book a Grab, type the address, and Wi-Fi phrases cover common app-payment follow-ups.
